examples.label: Plan picker with three tiers and descriptions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cbc-plans" name="plans[]" label="Choose the plans to compare" description="Pick as many as you like, we will line them up side by side." class="max-w-md">
  <:checkbox value="starter" title="Starter" description="Up to 3 projects and 5 GB of asset storage" />
  <:checkbox value="growth" title="Growth" description="Unlimited projects and 50 GB of asset storage" checked={true} />
  <:checkbox value="scale" title="Scale" description="Dedicated infrastructure and priority support" />
</.component>

examples.label: Notification channels laid out in two columns
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cbc-channels" name="channels[]" label="Where should we reach you?" cols="two" cols_gap="small" variant="bordered" color="primary" class="max-w-lg">
  <:checkbox value="email" icon="hero-envelope" title="Email" description="A digest every morning" checked={true} />
  <:checkbox value="sms" icon="hero-device-phone-mobile" title="SMS" description="Only for outages" />
  <:checkbox value="chat" icon="hero-chat-bubble-left-right" title="Team chat" description="Posted to #alerts" />
  <:checkbox value="push" icon="hero-bell" title="Push" description="Browser and mobile app" />
</.component>

examples.label: Checkout add-ons with the checkbox visible on each card
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cbc-addons" name="addons[]" label="Add-ons" description="Billed monthly alongside your plan." show_checkbox={true} reverse={true} variant="outline" color="success" padding="medium" class="max-w-md">
  <:checkbox value="backups" title="Nightly backups" description="30 days of restore points, $9 per month" checked={true} />
  <:checkbox value="cdn" title="Global CDN" description="Edge caching in 12 regions, $19 per month" />
  <:checkbox value="sla" title="99.99% SLA" description="One hour response, around the clock, $49 per month" />
</.component>
